Sum coordinates alpha,beta,gamma in U are distinct with product 1 and conversely recover triples. Inclusion-exclusion gives T=m^2-3m+2g, opposites give exactly 3(m-2g) bad triples and six per size-three fiber. All other triples extend uniquely to four via missing quartic root. value.rationale: A natural polynomial x^2+x^q across all odd quadratic extensions receives a complete fiber distribution. The image size has a surprisingly uniform closed form independent of the cubic regime, while size-1 through size-4 fibers vary with gcd(3,q+1); the structural norm-one triple argument explains the arithmetic distinction. This answers a natural exact value-set and fiber-invariant question, beyond routine generic bounds.
